item.title: Tree in garden of 16 Starcross Street, 21st August
item.description:
The tree is extremely large and has grown significantly over the surrounding properties. Several substantial branches are now hanging very low over our property and outdoor terrace. Given their size and weight, I am concerned about the risk of branches falling, particularly during high winds or bad weather, and potentially causing injury or damage to the property. The tree is also directly above the terrace and is causing a significant amount of bird fouling. The terrace, furniture and surrounding area are repeatedly covered in bird droppings. This is making the outdoor space difficult to use and creates an ongoing hygiene issue A combination of the two dangers, mean this tree needs pruning. It has been a long time and used to be pruned more regularly

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 15-20, Starcross Street, Fitzrovia, Greater London

item.title: The lift indicators are not working ., 21st August
item.description:

Please arrange for the lift indicators to be inspected and repaired as soon as possible. I have attached photographs showing the faulty indicators and the lift number. Thanks
